context: Use the bundled fictional spreadsheet 'gradebook'. Its cells (row by row, left to right) are: A1 = Student; B1 = Quiz; C1 = Exam; D1 = Final; E1 = Grade; A2 = Ines; B2 = 88; C2 = 92; D2 = =ROUND((B2+2*C2)/3,1); E2 = =IF(D2>=90,"A",IF(D2>=80,"B","C")); A3 = Kofi; B3 = 79; C3 = 85; D3 = =ROUND((B3+2*C3)/3,1); E3 = =IF(D3>=90,"A",IF(D3>=80,"B","C")); A4 = Lena; C4 = 70; D4 = =ROUND((B4+2*C4)/3,1); E4 = =IF(D4>=90,"A",IF(D4>=80,"B","C")); A5 = Mateo; B5 = excused; C5 = 95; D5 = =ROUND((B5+2*C5)/3,1); E5 = =IF(D5>=90,"A",IF(D5>=80,"B","C")); A7 = Class average; D7 = =AVERAGE(D2:D4); A8 = Quiz mean; B8 = =AVERAGE(B2:B5); A9 = Ines, unrounded; D9 = =(B2+2*C2)/3. Unlisted cells are empty. Evaluate each target under the stated rules: arithmetic is exact (fractions); a formula whose result is an empty cell reports the number 0; only an unlisted cell is empty. Note: an empty cell used as an operand is 0; text used as an operand is #VALUE!; ROUND rounds half away from zero to the given digits; AVERAGE over a range or cell reference skips text, booleans and empty cells but stops at an error; IF coerces its condition to a boolean and evaluates only the chosen branch; an error inside a comparison makes the comparison that error. Report numbers as decimals with at least 8 significant figures (tolerance 1e-6 x max(1, |exact|)), texts exactly, booleans as TRUE/FALSE, and errors as their exact code.
